subject: POC Trial RACI & Next Steps — Clearlake Health

Subject: POC Trial RACI & Next Steps — Clearlake Health

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary / goals
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for patient-facing summarization and clinical note generation across 2 pilot clinics.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for 512 token context for demo queries
  - Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent user sessions during clinic hours
  - Quality: top-3 precision on clinical extraction tasks >= 85% vs. current baseline
  - Security: data residency in our US region, support for customer-managed KMS, and SOC 2 evidence review

POC scope & timeline
- 2-week trial (sandbox) followed by a 4-week pilot in production-mirroring environment
- Target start: Dec 1, 2026 (flexible based on CLE deployment windows)

Evaluation plan
- We'll provide an evaluation harness (prompt sets + ground-truth) to run nightly evals and produce a quality dashboard
- Weekly check-ins to review metrics and blockers

Ownership / RACI ask
- Can you confirm who owns the following on your side so we can map responsibilities?
  - Infrastructure / network (VPC, firewall / whitelisting)
  - Application (integration points, API owners)
  - Security / compliance (KMS, audits)
  - Procurement (PO, NDAs, contract contacts)

Attachments: I attached a draft POC plan and a simple RACI template for your review (clearlake-poc-plan.xlsx, clearlake-raci.pdf).

Next steps
1) Please confirm the internal contacts for infra, app, security, and procurement
2) Confirm the proposed start date or suggest alternatives
3) We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff once contacts are confirmed

Thanks,
Lauren

Thanks Ellen — really helpful. Drafting a suggested RACI below (high-level) so we can lock ownership quickly. Feel free to edit and assign specific people on your side where I left roles as CLE-owner.

Suggested RACI (Redwood vs. Clearlake)
- Responsible (R): person(s) doing the work
- Accountable (A): final decision owner
- Consulted (C): consulted during work
- Informed (I): kept in the loop

1) Infrastructure & Network
- R: Clearlake Infra (Rajiv)
- A: Clearlake Infra (Rajiv)
- C: Aditya Rao (Redwood Solutions Eng)
- I: Marissa Cole (Redwood CSM)

2) Application Integration (API + EHR connector)
- R: Clearlake App (Tom)
- A: Clearlake App (Tom)
- C: Marissa Cole (CSM), Aditya Rao (SE)
- I: Lauren Bishop (Sales)

3) Security & Compliance (KMS, audit pack)
- R: Clearlake Security (Suresh)
- A: Clearlake Security (Suresh)
- C: Marissa Cole (CSM), Redwood Security (on request)
- I: Procurement

4) Procurement / Contracting
- R: Clearlake Procurement
- A: Clearlake Procurement
- C: Lauren Bishop (Sales), Legal (Redwood)
- I: Marissa Cole (CSM)

5) Trial Evaluation & Quality Metrics
- R: Redwood (Marissa + Aditya)
- A: Clearlake Clinical Lead (Ellen)
- C: Clearlake App (Tom)
- I: Lauren Bishop

Next steps I propose: 
- Lauren/Marissa/Aditya to schedule 30-min kickoff with Rajiv/Tom/Suresh + procurement (Nov 24 or 25). Please confirm availability.
- We'll circulate an infra requirements doc (infra-requirements.txt) and finalize network checklist prior to kickoff.
- We'll lock the start date after kickoff (aiming for Dec 1 start of sandbox).

Attachments: updated POC plan + RACI (attached).

Thanks — assigning initial action items: 
- Action (Redwood): Aditya to produce infra checklist and run a short tech demo during kickoff
- Action (Clearlake): Rajiv to share IP ranges and preferred connectivity model

Best,
Lauren
